description:
The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), Commander, Fleet Readiness Center (COMFRC) Procurement Group, Patuxent River, MD hereby gives notice of intent to award a Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF) Contract with a Base and 4 Option Years to Pioneering Decisive Solutions, Inc (PIDESO), 22560 Epic Dr., Ste 100, California, MD 20619-3097, (Cage Code: 4LVQ7), on a sole source basis in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.103-1(b), only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements.

COMFRC has a requirement to procure Contractor Engineering Technical Services (CETS) for the Aviation Rapid Action Team (ARAT); to include engineering and technical support services, component repair services, and logistics support analyses that will be in the following areas:   capability analysis; design and development; component testing and repair; component reverse engineering analysis; diagnoses and resolution of software and hardware failure modes; material obsolescence mitigation; technical documentation; workforce training; support equipment management; facilities and infrastructure planning; and logistics analysis of U.S. Naval Aviation maintenance and supply systems data.   

THIS NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES.  However, all responsible sources may submit a capability statement to Contract Specialist, Lori Sinclair at lori.b.sinclair.civ@us.navy.mil within fifteen (15) days of this posting. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement.  A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based on responses received as a result of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.  The Government will not reimburse interested parties for any presentation, marketing efforts, or data related to this notice.
